If you'd like to donate towards a Switch Developer Kit for me and PatricSquid to use to port the game to Switch, please consider donating to my Ko-fi here: https://ko-fi.com/alexsquiddev 💚✌



In the meantime, PC players will continue to receive free updates! We've got a full roadmap here! No promised timescales, but I will be working hard at my full-time job to fund these future updates. Doodle Champs is an entirely self-funded passion project, so if you'd like to support and speed up future updates for this lil' arty-party game, consider supporting me on Ko-fi. All funds go directly towards development. 💚✌

notes.title: DOODLE CHAMPS IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=I7ToU1ty1HU;full][/previewyoutube]

The ultimate arty-party game for artists and doodlers alike IS HERE! Play an exciting assortment of doodle-tastic party games with endless replayability, or just draw on a shared online canvas with your friends! Doodle Champs is optimized for play with Wacom tablets, but all pen-wielders and mouse-masters are welcome!

Free of subscription services, microtransactions, AI, and NFT nonsense. Doodle Champs is my gift to the art community. I wanted to make a place for artists to hang out and play fun mini-games together, but not just basic touch-functionality games - I wanted functional pen pressure, something I've never seen implemented into other art games have implemented to this day. 

I'm incredibly proud of how the game's turned out, with 4 insanely replayable, hilariously fun party games that never fail to get a laugh. If you love to doodle, grab some friends, jump into any game mode and I guarantee you'll have a blast!

No go out there, and be a DOODLE CHAMP! 🎨👑

- AlexSquid

TikTok | YouTube | Bluesky | Official Site

notes.title: Final Demo Update & Patch Notes!
notes.content:
Hey Champs! It's update time! This is the final planned update for the free demo version of Doodle Champs, but it's a big one with plenty of fixes and quality of life updates to ensure your demo experience is doodle-tastic. 🎨

Patch notes:

 Fixed a bug where players got stuck in the settings menu.
 Fixed a bug where players couldn't proceed due to desynchronisation on slower PCs. 
 Fixed a bug with the custom prompt generator.
 New & improved settings menu (settings now apply immediately).
 Chaos Mode: New UI.
 Chaos Mode: Customise Chaos Orb frequency! [Off / Low / Med / High]
 Chaos Mode: Improved animations.
 Pencil Pushers: "Watch tutorial together" feature added for party host.
 Pencil Pushers: Added missing glow behind BOSSMAN during "Buy It" animation.
 Pencil Pushers: Reduced tutorial.
 Music volume adjusted to 70% on first launch.
 Music system completely re-written.
 Art Assembly: Added Sketch Pad! (Draw on a secret pad while you wait for friends to finish).
 Art Assembly: Colour picker / eyedropper tool now works on other player's art! (Cool!).
 Art Assembly: Improved tutorial for drawing ARMS (Auto shows up before you draw too).
 Art Assembly: Timer is now set for the whole round, not per body part.
 Art Assembly: "Round Over" only shows up when the round is over. Not when you're done drawing.

And with that, we're already hard at work on the full release version of the game, including Canvas Crew mode, all 100 Steam Achievements, a complete overhaul of the inventory system, and more! ⭐ Exciting times await! 

Please join the Discord in the main menu to post your art and follow updates about the development of Doodle Champs! 🦑🎨

- AlexSquid

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
Hey Doodle Champs! 🎨

We're planning on full Steam Deck compatibility once the main PC version of the game has been completed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41576977/3048923f5f0556cdbfe2efbe5207ad45a4ffe674.jpg
Demo Compatibility Status
I'm happy to say that the Doodle Champs Demo works surprisingly well on Steam Deck! This is a surprise because we haven't added any official support for it yet, this is purely a byproduct of working on other types of peripheral support. 

You can draw by using your finger on the touch screen, or move the cursor with the Right Joystick and Press R2 to draw. The same goes for interacting with the menus.

Enhance your experience!
If you want to enhance your experience further, I suggest using any standard touch screen stylus.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41576977/f6a3872c5d8c49b26b11ee97d3fef1ba1f89fc2c.jpg
Planned support
We're hoping to fully support the Steam Deck version after release, actually looking into comfortable key bindings and ensuring the touch support feels as good as it possibly can. Don't expect Pen Pressure though, as the Steam Deck's touch screen only supports a single level of pressure.

Thanks for playing the Doodle Champs Demo! ✌🎨 If you create any masterpieces on Steam Deck please post 'em in the Discord! (Join from Main Menu)

Important Update: 
On launch day Steam Deck is less compatible than it was in the Demo, meaning now only touch controls are working, and button controls are temporarily disabled. If you'd like to play on Steam Deck at this time, I'd recommend using a touch pen, and hitting "reset" in the in game settings menu. This should set your steam deck to the optimal screen settings for now.

Have no fear, we intend to work towards 100% compatibility on Steam Deck - making the experience as enjoyable as possible.

- AlexSquid
